user.title: Site and weather
user.description: Location of the PV system and the weather forecast sources.

data_description.name: Name for this PV system.
data_description.latitude: Site latitude in decimal degrees (north positive).
data_description.longitude: Site longitude in decimal degrees (east positive).
data_description.elevation: Site elevation above sea level, in metres. Affects air mass and clear-sky irradiance.
data_description.weather_entities: One or more weather entities (for example Pirate Weather or OpenWeatherMap) that provide hourly forecasts with cloud coverage. When several are selected their cloud cover and temperature are averaged.
data_description.inverter_ac_power: Maximum AC output of the inverter(s), in watts. Output is clipped at this value. Use 0 if there is no limit to apply.

array.title: First PV array
array.description: Describe one group of panels that share the same tilt and azimuth. You can add more arrays later.

data_description.name: For example: South roof.
data_description.dc_power: Total STC nameplate power of the modules in this array, in watts.
data_description.tilt: Panel tilt from horizontal: 0° is flat, 90° is vertical.
data_description.azimuth: Compass direction the panels face: 0° north, 90° east, 180° south, 270° west.
data_description.mounting: How the modules are mounted; this sets how hot the cells run.
data_description.temp_coefficient: Pmax temperature coefficient from the module datasheet (typically -0.26 to -0.45 %/°C).
data_description.losses: Combined soiling, wiring, mismatch, degradation and nameplate losses.
data_description.module_efficiency: Module efficiency at STC from the datasheet; used by the cell temperature model.
data_description.albedo: Fraction of light reflected by the ground (0.2 typical, about 0.6–0.8 with fresh snow).

init.title: Calibration and tuning

data_description.production_sensor: Leave empty to disable calibration. Changing the sensor discards previously measured values.
data_description.turbidity_scale: Multiplier on the Linke turbidity climatology. Values above 1 model hazier skies (lower clear-sky output); below 1, clearer skies. Leave at 1, especially when calibration is enabled.

init.description: Select a sensor that measures your actual PV production so the forecast can learn your system's real losses, horizon shading and your weather provider's cloud bias. It needs long-term statistics: an energy sensor (kWh, state class total or total increasing) or a power sensor (W, state class measurement). Calibration improves over 1-3 weeks of data.

error.production_sensor_missing: The selected sensor does not exist.
error.production_sensor_invalid: The sensor must be an energy sensor with state class total/total increasing, or a power sensor with state class measurement.

no_weather_data.message: No usable weather forecast with cloud coverage: {details}

no_arrays.title: {name} has no PV arrays
no_arrays.description: The Solar Forecast entry {name} has no PV arrays configured, so no forecast can be made. Add a PV array to the entry from its integration page.
